propositions: Override table _MODEL_ID_CAPABILITY_OVERRIDES lacks rows enabling native_structured_output and native_output_with_thinking for measured Bedrock cells (sonnet-4-6 adaptive thinking, haiku-4-5-20251001-v1:0) despite E1 measurement confirming support.

Field native_output_with_thinking is omitted from ModelCapabilities construction at three sites (_capabilities_from_profile, string-fallback path, _intersect_capabilities), causing override values to be silently dropped and default to False.

_intersect_capabilities does not intersect native_output_with_thinking across FallbackModel chain candidates, so chains collapse the field to False even when all candidates support native-under-thinking.
Client-side validation of structured output (Pydantic validators enforcing ge/le bounds) must remain mandatory because Bedrock schema transform strips these constraints.
